description:
Turn your collection into a true “Showcase of the Immortals” with the official 2026 WWE Topps Now WrestleMania Vegas set! Included in this 15-card set are 14 of the biggest WWE Superstars competing at WrestleMania 42 and one (1) of the following cards guaranteed: serial-numbered base card parallel, WWE Legend Short Print, Legend SP Autograph Variation, redemption for Base Autograph Variation.

WrestleMania 42 will take place at Allegiant Stadium in Paradise, Nevada on Saturday, April 18 and Sunday, April 19.

Capturing all the excitement of World Wrestling Entertainment – Topps NOW brings the biggest moments directly to your collection!

Your Hero. Your Team. Your Moment. ™

Topps NOW celebrates the greatest moments... as they happen! Only available at Topps.com. Print runs for every card are released in the WWE Topps NOW Archive. 

All sales are final. Print runs revealed after sales window expires. Art subject to change. Not responsible for typographical/printer errors. In an effort to mitigate our carbon footprint, shipments may be grouped together within the same order. Large orders may be consolidated into bulk packaging at Topps’ discretion.
